sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description plus the cited guides; nothing is copied. Three trophies are flagged unconfirmed because no source has pinned down their trigger yet.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops last — there is no separate task behind it. The usual final steps are A Long Road (100% completion) and the last collectible counts, so treat this as the finish line of the whole roadmap rather than a trophy to chase on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. Play through the intro as Lucia and Jason until the mission completes — it is the first story beat of the game and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies pop at the end of each chapter, so just keep playing the story in order — there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy, it pops when the chapter's final mission ends — play the story straight through and it comes to you.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The chapter trophies are the easiest part of the list: finish the chapter and the trophy follows, no side task required.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. One chapter remains after this one — keep the story moving and the next chapter trophy follows in turn.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission (Chapter 5) and watch the credits roll — this gold pops with it. It is story-only, so the only requirement is reaching the end of the campaign.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop the moment their named mission ends — follow the story marker and complete the job.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are long, so keep a manual save before starting one — the trophy itself only needs the mission completed once.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. It unlocks as the story reaches it — no extra objective, just complete the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Story mission trophies cannot be missed by skipping side content — they wait for you in the campaign.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Complete the takedown objective and the trophy pops when the mission wraps up.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the named story missions, so it pops on completion like the others — no side requirement.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: the full story, every activity type, all collectibles, all challenges and the side strands. Open the in-game stats page to see what is still missing — it lists each category's progress. This is the longest grind on the list and usually the last trophy before the Platinum, so leave the cleanup pass for after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and airtime all count toward the total. The counter climbs across the whole playthrough, so stunt jumps off ramps and highway crests while travelling add up for free; in the cleanup pass, loop a known jump line until the number hits 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — bowling, fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games and the rest. One round of each is enough; you do not need to win any of them. The activities are marked on the map, so work down the icons one by one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each drill's scoring first with a slow clean run, pick the most accurate weapon for the range, and replay the silver ones until they turn gold — the ranges are repeatable, so no medal is ever locked out.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Fly each course once slowly to learn the gates, then push for the win — a clean line beats raw speed, and each location only needs one victory.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street, off-road and water races all count as long as each is a different event. Replays of the same race do not add to the count, so spread your wins across the map's race markers.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge spot, keep the tension meter in its safe zone, and reel steadily instead of yanking — a snapped line costs the attempt, but the challenge can be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full run of any arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest game on the cabinet and play it through to its end screen; a high score is not required.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Work through Andy's mission strand in order — his jobs appear as you progress — and the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Side strands stay available after the story, so this is a Stage 2 cleanup job.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's strand to its last job — the trophy is tied to the strand's ending, not to any single trick inside the mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is a bike-and-road series — ride it out to the last job and the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Pick up the '?' encounters as they appear on the map and finish each strand to its end — a strand only counts once its final mission is done, so half-finished encounters do not add up.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Work Randy's strand in order and the trophy pops at his last job — like the other side-character finals, it is a Stage 2 job after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand ends with this job — complete his missions in order and the trophy follows the finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the ONE trophy the guides flag as possibly missable: a meditation spot can stop being available after its area's story beats pass, so meditate at every spot the moment you find it, and keep a manual save from before story missions in a new area. If a spot is gone, reload the earlier save — do not push the story forward hoping it comes back.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until he marks the animal, then track it — bring a scoped rifle, approach downwind, and take the shot when it is still. The hunt can be retried if the animal spooks.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, side locations and mission rewards — so grab every card you see. Check the collection menu to see which set is one card short and hunt that card first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Photograph landmarks, murals and viewpoints whenever the prompt appears — the count climbs as you explore, so make it a habit in every new district rather than a single grinding session.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover driving, shooting, exploration and more — open the challenges menu and clear the easiest ones first (short drives, simple shots), then work down the list in the cleanup pass.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build heat with your partner in the car, then break line of sight, switch vehicles or hide until the stars clear — the trophy pops once the heat is fully gone with your partner still beside you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the heat on between shops — drive straight from one to the next and do not let the stars drop. Plan a route of three close shops before you start.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride anything new — each first sighting logs it. Car meets, highways and traffic-heavy streets fill the list fast; rare vehicles count the same as common ones, so volume beats rarity.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait until a group is clustered, trigger Combat Focus, and chain headshots before the meter runs out — open areas with five or more enemies are the place to try it.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA airport. Get to the airfield, grab a plane and take off without a flight plan — expect an immediate wanted level, so climb fast and break away from the runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the trophy is tied to the tank challenge. Lure or steal a Rhino and complete its objective; heavy weapons, distance and cover help, and the challenge is repeatable if the first attempt goes wrong.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet at night, avoid the cameras and the guards' sightlines, take what you need and leave before any alarm trips — if you are spotted, the attempt fails and you start over.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Plan each vault, hit it, and lose the wanted level after every one — the count only rises on a clean escape, so a busted run does not add to the total.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ram or breach the truck, grab the cash, and break away before the response units box you in — a fast car parked nearby is the difference between an escape and a bust.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road and visit every named district — the map shades in as you go and the counter shows what is left. Mop up the last few areas with a slow drive through the countryside and the Keys.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang, hit it and get clear — the gangs are spread across the map, so this is a tour of Leonida's underworld and the counter shows which gang you still owe.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront bar spot, order the cocktail and let the scene play — the trophy pops once the moment finishes, so do not walk away mid-drink.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's front window and out the other side — pick a straight run-up and commit to the speed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a frame and complete the follow-through on your throw — a full game is not required, just the finished motion.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no source has pinned down the trigger yet. The description ('A partnership with mass appeal') points to a story moment, but the exact scene or requirement is not confirmed anywhere we could verify. Do not chase a specific method; play the story and this entry will be updated once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one. Keep choosing whenever the game offers a branch, in story missions and side content alike, and the counter climbs. Treat the 500 figure as PSN's published target; the in-game counter is the authority on what is left.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no source has pinned down the trigger yet. 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding after a failure, but the exact event is not confirmed anywhere we could verify. Do not grind retries on a guess; this entry will be updated once a guide confirms the method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no source has pinned down the trigger yet. The description hints at witnessing something strange, but what it is and where it happens is not confirmed anywhere we could verify. Flagged unconfirmed rather than guessed; this entry will be updated once a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a target slowly and land a melee hit from the moving vehicle — a straight, slow pass gives you the best chance to connect.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Keep feeding marked bills to your laundering contacts after every big score — the total accumulates across the playthrough, so it finishes itself if you launder after each heist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades — every shop purchase counts toward the total, so it climbs naturally and finishes in the cleanup pass with a few big purchases.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the map — check the property menu to see which ones you still lack, and save the expensive ones for after the big heists when cash is plentiful.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Bring 10 different vehicles to the app's registration and log each one — any vehicle counts, so register whatever you are driving whenever the option appears.
trophies.name: On the Spot
